_info: Bronze-age damage tables. Each weapon has entries per hit tier with fx effects. Engine picks one at random.

fumble.text: Dagger slips in wet fingers. He steps inside your reach.
Too short. He leans back. Blade takes air.
He catches your wrist. Twists. Dagger nearly drops.

miss.text: Quick stab. He shifts. Misses by a finger.
Dagger scrapes across his guard. Sparks, nothing.
He blocks with forearm. Leather saves him.

glancing.text: Dagger opens his forearm. Shallow. He hisses.
Nick across the ribs. Blood beads.

solid.text: Dagger sinks into the side. Not deep, but he doubles over.
Under the arm. Dagger finds the gap. He gasps.

critical.text: Dagger drives into the neck. Arterial. He grabs the wound. Can't hold it.
Dagger punches through the eye. He drops. Instant.

devastating.text: Dagger into the throat. Twists. Pulls free. He falls without a sound.
Under the chin. Up. Through. His eyes go wide, then empty.

fumble.text: Hunting knife catches on his belt. Wrist twists.
Slash goes wide. He steps past you.
Grip slips. Blood or sweat. Edge bites your own thumb.

miss.text: Quick cut. He's quicker.
Hunting knife scrapes across leather. No blood.

glancing.text: Opens his forearm. Not deep. He switches grip.
Hunting knife nicks his cheek. Blood runs down his chin.

solid.text: Hunting knife slashes across his ribs. Leather parts. Blood wells.
Deep cut into sword arm. Fingers weaken. Weapon droops.

critical.text: Hunting knife opens his belly. Long. He folds, hands pressed to the wound.
Across the throat. Fast. Red line, then cascade. Done.

devastating.text: Two cuts. One to open, one to finish. He was fast. You were faster.
Hunting knife finds the neck. Sawing edge does its work. He drops mid-stride.

fumble.text: Spear slips in sweating hands. You stumble forward, exposed.
Overcommit on the thrust. He sidesteps. Spear buries in dirt.
He catches the shaft. Pulls. Face-first into the mud.

miss.text: He twists aside. Spear point takes air.
Too slow. He reads the thrust.
Spear thuds into his shield. Point doesn't get through.

glancing.text: Spear grazes his forearm. First blood.
Spear pierces outer thigh, shallow. He shifts weight.
Tip catches leather. Not enough.

solid.text: Spear buries below the ribs. He staggers backward.
Spear drives into the shoulder. Arm drops.
Through his guard. Blood on the shaft.

critical.text: Spear drives through the gut. Pins him to the earth. Mouth opens. No sound.
Spear pierces the neck. Arterial spray catches the man behind him.
Through the shield. Deep. He falls.

devastating.text: Spear punches straight through the chest. He walks backward off the shaft. The line breaks.
Spear through the eye. He drops mid-stride. Warriors on both sides freeze.

fumble.text: Javelin slips on the throw. Goes wide. You're empty-handed.
Overcommit on the thrust. He sidesteps. Javelin buries in dirt.

miss.text: Javelin passes a hand's width from his face.
He reads the thrust. Steps inside.

glancing.text: Javelin grazes his arm. Blood runs.
Javelin scrapes across leather. Shallow puncture.

solid.text: Javelin drives into his thigh. He drops to one knee.
Javelin sinks into the side. He doubles over, hand on the shaft.

critical.text: Javelin punches through the chest. He stares at the shaft. Falls.
Javelin pierces the neck. He grabs it with both hands. Too late.

devastating.text: Javelin through the chest from thirty paces. Dead before it registered.
Javelin pins him to the ground. Feet kick once. Then still.

fumble.text: Caught on his guard. Wrist twists.
Slash at air. He's already past you.
Grip slips. Wet hands.

miss.text: Parried. Sparks. Arm rings.
Quick cut. He's quicker.
Finger's width from his throat. Miss.

glancing.text: Forearm cut. Bleeds freely.
Nicks his cheek. Keeps fighting.
Opens his side. Shallow.

solid.text: Shortsword cuts deep into sword arm. Grip loosens.
Slash across belly. He folds.
Under his guard, into ribs. He gasps.

critical.text: Across the throat. Fast. Done.
Neck-shoulder gap. Deep. Drops instant.
Shortsword opens him from shoulder to ribs. He looks down. Then falls.

devastating.text: Two cuts. Dead after the first. Second was for his friends.
Through leather, skin, bone. His knees fold.

fumble.text: Longsword catches on a root. Heavy blade pulls you off balance.
Overswing. Weight carries you past him. Back exposed.
Grip slips on the long hilt. Edge turns in the hand.

miss.text: Iron sings through empty air. Close, not close enough.
He ducks under the swing. Iron is fast but he is faster.

glancing.text: Longsword opens his forearm. Iron cuts clean. He hisses.
Edge catches his hip. Iron bites through leather like it isn't there.

solid.text: Longsword cuts deep into the shoulder. Iron through bronze. He screams. Arm hangs.
Longsword slashes across his ribs. Iron opens what bronze couldn't protect.
Deep into the thigh. Iron finds the bone. He drops.

critical.text: Longsword takes the arm at the elbow. Iron through bone. Clean. He stares at the stump.
Longsword opens him from shoulder to hip. One stroke. Iron. The word spreads after.
Across the neck. Iron doesn't stop at bone the way bronze does. Head tilts. Falls.

devastating.text: Longsword cleaves through helm, skull, everything. Iron against bronze is no contest. The enemy line shatters.
One stroke takes him apart. The iron sings. Warriors on both sides stop and stare at the blade.

fumble.text: Axe buries in a root. Too late to free.
Axe glances off shield. Haft cracks.
Too wide. He steps inside the arc.

miss.text: He ducks. Axe takes a branch.
Heavy. Slow. He sees it coming.
Shield catches the axe head. Arms jar.

glancing.text: Axe opens his arm. He switches grip.
Axe splinters his shield edge. He felt that.
Axe scrapes ribs. Leather saved him.

solid.text: Axe chops into the shoulder. He screams. Arm hangs.
Axe through shield, through arm. Falls.
Heavy chop to the thigh. Bone. Done.

critical.text: Axe cleaves shield in two. Second swing finds flesh.
Overhead. He raises arms. Doesn't help.
Axe in the neck. Sticks. Foot on his chest to pull free.

devastating.text: Axe cleaves shoulder to sternum. The sound carries across the field.
One blow. He comes apart. The enemy breaks.

fumble.text: Hammer swings wide. Weight carries you past him.
Hammer hits the ground. Shock runs up to the shoulder.
Too slow. He steps inside before the swing lands.

miss.text: Hammer whistles past his head. Air.
He ducks. Hammer takes a fence post.

glancing.text: Hammer clips his shoulder. He winces, keeps coming.
Hammer catches his hip. Stumbles. Not down.

solid.text: Hammer smashes his ribs. He doubles over wheezing.
Hammer hits the side of his head. Jaw dislocates. He drops.
Hammer breaks the collarbone. Snap. He grabs his own shoulder.

critical.text: Hammer caves the helm. He drops. Four hours before he opens his eyes. If he opens them.
Hammer shatters his kneecap. He screams and goes down clawing at his own leg.
Hammer to the back of the neck. He goes rigid, then limp.

devastating.text: Full overhead. Hammer crumples the helm like tin. Skull beneath is no better.
Hammer caves the chest. Ribcage folds. He sits down carefully. Then forward, face in the dirt.

fumble.text: Wild swing. Weight pulls you off balance.
Club hits ground. Shock runs up your arm.
He ducks. You spin, back exposed.

miss.text: Too slow. He steps inside.
Club whistles past his head. Air.
Blocked on forearm. He grins.

glancing.text: Club clips his shoulder. He winces, keeps coming.
Club catches his hip. Stumbles. Not down.
Club hits the forearm. He switches hands.

solid.text: Club cracks his ribs. He doubles over.
Club hits his jaw. Teeth and blood. He drops.
Club breaks the collarbone. Snap. He drops his weapon.

critical.text: Club hits the temple. Eyes empty. Falls.
Club snaps the collarbone. He crumples.
Club across the face. He spins, drops.

devastating.text: Skull caves. Everyone stops. Even the enemy.
Club lifts him off his feet. Lands broken. Warriors roar.

fumble.text: String snaps back. Fingers bleed.
Arrow veers wild. Hits a tree.
Fumble the nock. Arrow drops.

miss.text: Hand's width from his face. Air.
Thuds in dirt at his feet.
Wind takes it. Gone.

glancing.text: Arrow grazes his arm. He snaps the shaft, keeps coming.
Through the ear. Finger lower, dead.
Skims his ribs. Standing.

solid.text: Arrow in the chest. He sits down slowly.
Arrow in the thigh. Falls. Can't crawl.
Through hand into belly. Stays.

critical.text: Arrow through the eye. Drops mid-stride.
Arrow in the throat. He grabs it. Shouldn't have.
Center chest. Looks at fletching. Falls.

devastating.text: Hundred paces. Through leather, rib, heart. Dead before the bowstring sound reached him.
Arrow pins him to the tree. Feet leave the ground. Friends run.

fumble.text: Stone slips on release. Goes behind you.
Sling wraps around your wrist. Stone drops.

miss.text: Stone whistles past his head. Close.
Cracks off his shield. He barely flinches.

glancing.text: Stone clips his shoulder. He stumbles, keeps coming.
Stone catches his hip. He winces.

solid.text: Stone hits his ribs. Crack. He doubles over.
Stone smashes into his face. Blood. He staggers.

critical.text: Stone hits the temple. He drops like a puppet with cut strings.
Stone shatters his kneecap from thirty paces. Down. Screaming.

devastating.text: Perfect shot. Stone caves the skull. He was dead before gravity took him.
Stone through the eye socket. Fifty paces. David's weapon. Goliath falls.

fumble.text: Swings wild, loses balance. Warriors jeer.
Crude spear snaps on shield. Stares at stump.

miss.text: Lunges. You step aside. Predictable.
Glances off armour. Barely felt.

glancing.text: Bone club catches forearm. Bruise.
Crude blade, thigh cut. Stings.

solid.text: Sharpened bone into side. Pain blooms.
Bone club hits ribs. Crack. Iron taste.
Stone-tipped spear, shoulder. Arm numb.

critical.text: Faster than expected. Opens your face. Blood in eyes.
Bone club to the helm. World rings. One knee.
Tackles you down. Teeth near throat.

devastating.text: War-pick in shield arm. Bone snaps. Own scream from far away.
Three at once. Down under grey skin and stone blades.

strong: Warriors press forward. They smell victory.
holding: Line holds. Bronze on wood. No one gives ground.
Steady. Sweat and blood and patience.
wavering: Man on your left stumbles. Line bends. Eyes on you.
Warriors bunch too tight. Discipline slipping.
breaking: A warrior falls. Two step back. Line gone.
They're running. Enough of them. Shield wall is memory.
A boy drops his spear. Others follow.
